name: Breath Awareness Meditation
equipment: A quiet space and a comfortable seat
instructions: Find a comfortable seated position with your spine tall and shoulders relaxed.
Close your eyes or soften your gaze, and take three slow, deep breaths.
Let your breathing return to its natural rhythm, and simply notice the sensation of air moving in and out.
Whenever your mind wanders, gently guide your attention back to the breath without judgment.
Continue for the full 5 minutes, then slowly open your eyes and notice how you feel.
